data_integrity.headline: Yahoo's DAILY-bar array was never backfilled for 2026-09-03, and preflight.py cleared it anyway.
data_integrity.detail: build_prices.py wrote 2,443 tickers but only 8 with a 09-03 bar (ADEA, APH, FXO, HUBB, JMST, PHYS, SHEL, VCX). prices.parquet, chart.py, held_book.py and regime_check.py all therefore still read 09-02. preflight.py reported '[ok] prices.parquet -> 2026-09-03' and printed 'clear' because it checks max(date) across ALL tickers -- 8 backfilled names out of 2,443 were enough to pass. This is a FALSE CLEAR on the one check that exists to stop a lane reading a stale panel. Proposed fix: scope the check to ticker='SPY', or require a coverage fraction.
data_integrity.session_recovered_from: meta.regularMarketPrice (regularMarketTime 20:00 UTC = 16:00 ET official close) AND the 5-minute array (range=2d&interval=5m, 79 bars). Both agree EXACTLY on SPY/QQQ/IWM. ^VIX's daily bar IS populated (14.32), which is how the daily/intraday split was isolated.
data_integrity.not_patched: prices.parquet was deliberately NOT patched with reconstructed bars -- that would contaminate the regression gate's own history to fix a one-session display lag.
data_integrity.hz_end_impact: _calendar.hz_end builds its grid from SPY in prices.parquet, so the grid ends 09-02 and every horizon from 09-03 is EXTRAPOLATED on a 5-day week. Verified against the true NYSE calendar incl. Labor Day 09-07: h5 -> 2026-09-11 CORRECT, h10 -> 2026-09-18 CORRECT (the +1 outward rounding happens to absorb the holiday), but h3 -> 2026-09-08 against a true 2026-09-09, i.e. ONE SESSION SHORT and FAILING OPEN. Nothing gated on h3 tonight so no name leaked, but this is a live fail-open whenever a holiday sits inside an h3 window while the panel edge lags.
data_integrity.exit_grid_impact: The 09-03 exit day is missing from the exit-day grid entirely (dates jump 09-02 -> 09-04) and extrapolated exit dates include SATURDAYS (09-05, 09-12). Both are confined to unresolved future rows, which are excluded from every statistic, so the clustering key is sound for every row that enters a number.
